subject: ShellPkg/UefiShellDriver1: Flatten some functions
reasons: Code flattening/inversion of conditionals for readability; changes 'if (!err) { body }' to 'if (err) { return; } body' across three specific functions
Although the pattern (invert-if-and-early-return) is mechanically expressible, the flattening applies to only 3 named functions; the transformation is part of a larger refactoring series
Each instance requires verifying that the early return is semantically equivalent, which requires case-by-case reasoning
